Subject: Partner-led discovery - thanks + next steps

Hi Marissa / Mateo,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really helpful to get a sense of Redwood's approach to dedicated vs hosted inference and the routing/fallback story. Samir and I chatted and we'd like to move to a technical deep dive/demo next week so our cloud marketplace engineering and procurement partners can see integration surface and basic SSO/KMS requirements.

High-level asks from our side: 
- 30-45 minute technical demo focusing on private deployment & marketplace onboarding flow
- Quick runthrough of the KMS/HSM and audit log capabilities
- A short checklist we can share with our marketplace team on required artifacts for listing

Are you available for a slot next Tue/Wed afternoon PT? We can send a calendar invite once we pick a time.

Also, if you can share an agenda and any checklist/security questionnaire we should fill out, that would speed things up.

Thanks - Diane
Diane Park
Partnerships, CloudBridge Marketplace

- Tue 2027-03-23 3:30pm-4:15pm PT

- 5-10m: Q&A & next steps / mutual action plan

Next steps from Redwood: I'll loop in Connor (solutions engineer) to lead the technical portion and Mateo will be on the invite for procurement questions.
